$comment: Per-contributor override for /design-pull and /design-push. Copy to sync.local.json, which is
gitignored, and fill in the ids of YOUR OWN Claude Design projects.
Two individual Claude accounts cannot share a Design project, so each contributor works against
their own copies and the repo is the handoff. Without this file the skills fall back to the ids
in tokens.json, which are whoever set the mirror up first — fine for them, wrong for everyone
else, and pushing to another person's project is the one mistake here with no clean undo.
themeProjectId   DesignSync list_projects — it returns design-system projects you can write to
designProjectId  NOT in list_projects (that listing is filtered to design systems). Open the
design and take the id out of the URL:
Run /design-login once per session before either skill will work.
